note: The 'valid' proof was signed by the BTX wallet core (ui/qid.bundle.js). Negative cases are single mutations of it. Keys here are test-only.

cases.name: valid
cases.description: Genuine proof from the wallet that owns the address. Fresh, correct origin.

cases.name: wrong_login_pubkey
cases.description: login_pubkey replaced with a different wallet's pubkey. Root no longer rebuilds to the address.

cases.name: tampered_challenge_nonce
cases.description: Verifier is given a challenge with one nonce byte flipped. Signature no longer matches the digest.

cases.name: tampered_challenge_origin
cases.description: Verifier is given a challenge with a different rp_origin. Signature no longer matches the digest.

cases.name: tampered_signature
cases.description: One byte of the signature flipped.

cases.name: tampered_recovery_leaf_hash
cases.description: One byte of the recovery leaf hash flipped. Rebuilt root no longer matches the address.

cases.name: wrong_address
cases.description: A genuine proof for wallet A checked against wallet B's address.

cases.name: expired
cases.description: Cryptographically valid, but checked after the TTL window. verifyOwnership is true; verifySignIn is expired.

cases.name: origin_mismatch
cases.description: A genuine proof bound to otc.btx.example, presented to a DApp that expects another origin.

cases.name: nonce_replay
cases.description: The same fresh, valid proof submitted twice. First accepted, second rejected as nonce_used.
